text:
Sasha Ward: Quick async check on Optimize toolkit delivery — staging rollout targeted for Fri EOD. Need owners for: quant recommendations, batching/caching configs, and regression alert wiring. List blockers and owners?

Alex Chen: I can own quantization recommendations + model card updates. Current fav is `q4_0` for throughput, fall back to `fp16` for sensitive workloads. Will run perf sweep today.

Priya Nair: I'll take batching/caching suggestions and the autoscaler knob. Plan: validate default batch size across short/long seq distributions tomorrow. One blocker: missing perf trace for live prefix-cache hits (need trace hook from runtime).

Tess Morgan: can do the regression alert rules + example eval sets. I have a draft alert policy that ties to prompt set 03 (conversational) and embedding drift. Will post in the evals board.

Jamal Reed: FYI infra: dedicated staging pool is up but GPU util is low because current model variant uses CPU fallback on cold start. That's a capacity config we need to pin. Owner: @Sasha, can we pin rollout to variant v2-quant for staging?

Sasha Ward: @Jamal yes — pin to v2-quant for staging. Alex, can you confirm v2-quant perf + regression risk today so we can pin?

Alex Chen: Confirming sweep in progress. Early numbers: token latency down 18%, P95 improved, slight increase in hallucination rate on long-form prompts (tracking). I pushed notes to https://redwood.internal/docs/optimize/toolkit-rollout#quant-notes and added model-card diff.

Priya Nair: For batching defaults here's the snippet I'll propose (will test against 2k, 8k seq workloads):

```yaml
batching:
  max_tokens: 1024
  max_batch_size: 24
  prefer_latency: true
caching:
  prefix_cache: true
  kv_cache_ttl_secs: 600
quant:
  profile: q4_0
  fallback: fp16
```

Priya Nair: Note: set `max_batch_size` to 12 for latency-sensitive routes.

Tess Morgan: Alert wiring plan (short):
- baseline evals pushed (prompt-set-03)
- regressions: >=3% BLEU-like metric drop OR >=2x hallucination token rate -> page oncall + postmortem channel
- severity: minor (warning) -> slack; major -> page SRE

Maria Gomez: Heads-up for SDK: we'll need a small breaking change to expose `prefer_latency` flag in client configs. Can we keep it behind feature flag for 2 weeks? Owner: Maria.

Sasha Ward: Owners recap + action items:
- Quant recs + model card: Alex Chen (sweep finish today)
- Batching/caching defaults + tests: Priya Nair (validate tomorrow)
- Regression alerts + eval sets: Tess Morgan (draft by EOD)
- SDK flag for `prefer_latency`: Maria Gomez (feature flag rollout)
- Pin staging variant: Jamal Reed (apply once Alex greenlights)

Sasha Ward: Blockers called out: missing runtime trace hook (Priya) and slight quality hit on long-form (Alex). If either persists, we delay staged rollout by 48h.

Alex Chen: Quick ask — can @Priya drop the raw perf traces into the staging bucket when ready? I'll attach them to the model-card diff.

Priya Nair: yup will upload to s3://redwood-staging/optimize-traces/ by EOD.

deploy-bot: Deploy job #4921 queued for staging variant v2-quant. Status: pending approvals.

Jamal Reed: I'll hold the pin until deploy-bot shows success + Alex confirms quality signals.

Sasha Ward: Perfect. If anyone hits a blocker ping here or DM. Otherwise we'll reconvene if staging shows any regressions. :thumbsup:
